name: FLIXO Agent tool discovery finds the Background Remover capability
description: The Agent Studio tool browser must expose a matching canonical tool and allow it to populate the command.

planSteps.description: Enter `Background Remover` in the tools search field
Verify a Background Remover tool card is visible
Click the Background Remover tool card
Verify the Agent command field contains `Background Remover` or an equivalent instruction to use that tool
